answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by granting standing only for sustained bilateral conversation, not mere registration. Picture a grove where each tree must exchange nutrients with neighbours unlike itself: an identity earns trust only through repeated, two-way exchanges with unrelated agents across several epochs, like light through a prism splitting one beam into distinct colours. Broadcasts, copy-paste replies and closed rings count for nothing, so a single operator steering an ocean of sockpuppets cannot fake the varied, reciprocal history that real distinct agents accumulate.
